req.title: Reject duplicate playerId on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with an ID that already exists.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with a squad_number that already exists in the database. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a new unique squad_number returns 201 Created with correct payload fields, (2) a negative/EP case confirming a duplicate squad_number returns exactly 409 Conflict with the expected detail message, (3) a boundary/STC case confirming the state transition from first-create (201) to second-create-same-squad (409) is deterministic, (4) a DT case verifying that a different squad_number after a 409 still succeeds (ruling out side-effects), and (5) a BVA case using squad_number=1 (lowest pre-loaded value) to confirm the boundary duplicate is caught. All tests use exact status code assertions and exact response body field checks to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_new_player_unique_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows; squad numbers 1-26 are taken
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, squadNumber=99, position
Response body contains a valid UUID id field
trace: R-PLAYER-007: happy path — unique squad_number must succeed with 201
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_new_player_unique_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Centre-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Centre-Back"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None
    assert len(body["id"]) == 36

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_does_not_block_different_squad_number
preconditions: Squad number 10 exists (Messi); squad number 50 does not exist
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=50 — expect 201 (no side-effect from prior 409)
expected: Second POST returns HTTP 201 with squadNumber=50
trace: R-PLAYER-007: DT — 409 on duplicate must not corrupt state for subsequent unique inserts
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_does_not_block_different_squad_number():
    dup_payload = {
        "firstName": "Lionel",
        "lastName": "Messi",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger"
    }
    r_dup = client.post("/players/", json=dup_payload)
    assert r_dup.status_code == 409
    assert r_dup.json()["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."
    new_payload = {
        "firstName": "Fresh",
        "lastName": "Recruit",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Forward"
    }
    r_new = client.post("/players/", json=new_payload)
    assert r_new.status_code == 201
    body = r_new.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert body["firstName"] == "Fresh"
